description.p: Video Squisher makes video files smaller but keeps the quality you want, so they take less space on your disk, phone or cloud storage. Drop videos in, pick how small you want them at what quality, and it analyzes them to figure how small it can make them.

Two simple modes: 1. Pick a quality level with a slider, or 2. Set a target file size and Video Squisher works out the best way to hit it. Batch processing, watch folders, light and dark themes, all in a super simple setup.

Video Squisher is free to use with just some small limits: 5 videos per day, processed one at a time. A one-time purchase of Video Squisher Pro from www.kitkarl.com/squisher removes the limits, and adds features like batch processing and watch folders. No subscription, no recurring charges.

description.p: First Flatpak release: the app identifies as com.kitkarl.VideoSquisher so taskbars and launchers pin it correctly. Secure connections for license activation and update checks carry their own certificate bundle inside the app, and IPv4 is preferred on Linux, so activation works on minimal systems like SteamOS.
